0.original: Gelther does not like the way you are looking at him, but will let it pass if you deliver a message for him.

1.original: A somewhat enraged Gelther has demanded that you deliver a rather colorful ultimatum to Didilata, who has failed to repay his debt. Find Didilata and impress upon him the gravity of the situation.

2.original: Without hesitation, the Lalafell pledges to repay the money owed. Given his frantic stuttering, you have little reason to doubt his sincerity.

48.original: Hey, you! I saw you lookin' at me. You got somethin' to say? Huh!?

49.original: No? Well, <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> do! You know Didilata? Short, broke, never pays what he owes? Yeah, that bleedin' whoreson! Tell him to pay up, or I swear by the Twelve I'll beat him so hard it'll feel like the second comin' of Dalamud!

50.original: If I see that little shite's face, I'll end up poundin' him into a bloody pulp, like as not. So you go and tell him!

52.original: A-Alright, alright! I'll give back every gil I owe! I swear it!<hex:02100103>B-But no more beatings, I b-b-beg you!
